request.text: I need the iPhone 15 generation in the Mini size, new. Can you find an iPhone 15 mini for delivery to Beirut?

message:
Apple never made an iPhone 15 mini. The last mini was the 5.4-inch iPhone 13 mini; the standard iPhone 15 is larger at 6.1 inches.
Closest new alternatives, both listed in stock for Beirut delivery:
• IT Promax: iPhone 15 NEW — $660.00, delivery $4.00. VAT treatment is not stated.
• ITWorks Lebanon: iPhone 15 NEW — $660.00, delivery $5; prices include tax.
Both confirm new condition, but storage and color are unspecified in the checked listings.
For size comparison only: Mobileleb lists an iPhone 13 mini 128GB at $320.00, but it is Open Box, so it does not meet your new-condition requirement; delivery terms were not confirmed.
Suggestion: choose the standard iPhone 15 if generation matters most, and confirm storage and color before ordering.
